_doc: Phase 17: encouragement companions (data-driven). Adding a companion = a folder app/assets/companions/<id>/<pose>.webp + one entry here. subjects: list of subject ids or "*" (any subject, incl. future ones). poses lists the sprites that exist; missing poses fall back (think->idle, celebrate->happy). Selection: the subject's own companions first, then the '*' pool; never the same companion two sessions in a row (per child); the child can pin a favourite in the profile.
